comparator.sourceNotes: The Amsterdam programme follows Tables 4–6 of the 2026–2027 regulations. Five taught semesters contain 41 required units totalling 150 EC, and semester five provides 30 EC of minor study. Semester six includes 5 EC of Research Skills and the 12 EC individual BSc Assignment. The University of Twente awards the degree and VU Amsterdam is the delivery partner.

exception.reason: The three feasible UCR test schedules offer substantive design, computation, energy and anatomy study. Across the tested directions they do not provide the connected study of mechanical behaviour, materials, thermal and fluid engineering and the practical design and testing that define the Amsterdam curriculum.
exception.curriculumContext: Verified 180 EC English-taught Amsterdam curriculum under Tables 4–6, including 41 compulsory credited units, 30 EC of minor study, 5 EC of Research Skills and the 12 EC BSc Assignment.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Consumer Product Design teaches working mechanisms, testing and fabrication choices. Linear Systems, Robotics and Computational & Numerical Methods support modelling, feedback and manipulation. Sustainability Essentials gives introductory thermodynamics, stress and strain. Renewable System Design and Energy & Sustainability add technical and economic assessment of energy resources, and Life Cycle Analysis & Circular Economy supports product assessment. Anatomy and perception add medically relevant context. The three feasible test schedules and substantive reasoning are recorded in audit evidence. Limited availability was resolved for testing and does not determine the academic finding.

candidateAssessment.concept: Mechanical design, structures and smart manufacturing
candidateAssessment.assessment: Product design, feedback, robotics and quantitative modelling provide genuine parts of the enquiry. The tested plan lacks the linked progression in statics, stress and deformation, machine dynamics, material behaviour and manufacture needed to design and test structures and machines.

Renewable-system analysis and partner work, life-cycle assessment, consumer prototyping and energy demand, storage and yield are substantive. The stronger energy test still lacks engineering thermodynamics, the use of heat-transfer and fluid-mechanics models in design, and iterative thermal-system testing.

Functional Anatomy, Perception & Action, Robotics, Linear Systems and Consumer Product Design offer substantive contributions to anatomy, movement, sensing, control and prototypes. Even together they lack precision mechanisms, finite-element and elasticity analysis and the instrument-specific sequence of engineering, control, measurement and testing.

audience.programmeDescription: In the Amsterdam Mechanical Engineering degree, students design and test machines, manufacturing systems, energy systems and healthcare technology. Most teaching takes place in Amsterdam, with practical work also in Enschede. The University of Twente awards the degree.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related study in product prototyping, robotics, renewable energy and human anatomy. The Amsterdam degree connects these interests to mechanics, materials, thermal and fluid engineering and repeated workshop and laboratory projects. The available UCR courses cover parts of that work, with insufficient coverage of the engineering sequence for a comparable programme.

componentNotes.me-am-approved-minor-free-minor: Entry requires 90 EC, including at least 52 from year one, and at most 8 EC of unfinished courses that run during the minor semester. A self-designed minor needs prior approval.
componentNotes.me-am-202100011: The project applies fluid mechanics and heat transfer through aerodynamic investigation and testing.
